description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating various notification styles and interactions, including support for Android Wear devices, with methods to generate different notification types and handle user interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating various notification styles with support for Android Wear, including user interaction handling and notification generation methods.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures the notification style selection spinner.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection changes in the notification style spinner, updating the description accordingly.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Required override for spinner selection listener, no action needed.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click to generate the selected notification style, checking notification permissions first.

methods.name: generateBigTextStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a BIG_TEXT_STYLE notification with actions and intents.

methods.name: generateBigPictureStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a BIG_PICTURE_STYLE social post notification with remote input support.

methods.name: generateInboxStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays an INBOX_STYLE email notification with multiple lines.

methods.name: generateMessagingStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a MESSAGING_STYLE chat notification with support for wear devices and inline replies.

methods.name: openNotificationSettingsForApp
methods.description: Opens the app's notification settings screen for user to re-enable notifications.
